tenant_key_rule: TENANT entities use PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id,id), tenant-inclusive FK/index and FORCE RLS

RubricVersion.foreign_reference_rule: DiagnosisSession.rubric_version_id REFERENCES exact immutable RubricVersion row

check_constraints.name: ck_evidence_span_scores
check_constraints.expression: confidence_microunit BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000 AND evidence_strength_microunit BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000

check_constraints.name: ck_competency_score_confidence_coverage
check_constraints.expression: confidence_microunit BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000 AND evidence_coverage_microunit BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000 AND (score_microunit IS NULL OR score_microunit BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)

check_constraints.name: ck_content_item_recommendation_features
check_constraints.expression: cardinality(recommendation_feature_codes) > 0 AND duration_minutes > 0 AND prerequisite_codes IS NOT NULL AND accessibility_features IS NOT NULL AND region_availability_codes IS NOT NULL

check_constraints.name: ck_document_node_topology
check_constraints.expression: sibling_order >= 0 AND node_path IS NOT NULL
